# Rosetta's Final Selfie

The Rosetta spacecraft captured a stunning self-portrait just before releasing its tiny Philae lander toward a comet 472 million kilometers away, showing the spacecraft's gleaming solar panel with jets of dust and gas erupting from the comet's distinctive peanut-shaped nucleus looming beyond. This haunting final image from Philae's camera, taken by combining two exposures to show both bright sunlight and distant details, was snapped a mere 16 kilometers above the comet's surface and captured the dramatic moment before the lander began its historic descent.
